benign.description: Read-only SELECT queries with joins, LIKE and ORDER BY (drafts on query_db must not match).
messages: How many open tickets does each team have?
List the five newest employees in Engineering.

arguments.sql: SELECT t.team, count(*) FROM tickets t WHERE t.status = 'open' GROUP BY t.team ORDER BY 2 DESC
SELECT name, start_date FROM employees WHERE department = 'Engineering' ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT o.id, c.name FROM orders o JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.shipped_at >= current_date - 7
SELECT title FROM docs WHERE title LIKE '%policy%'
